description: This file provides classes and methods for handling OpenRouter's chat completion API, including request/response transformation, caching support, error handling, and streaming response parsing. It extends configurations from OpenAIGPTConfig and integrates with litellm for reasoning support and cost tracking.

classes.name: CacheControlSupportedModels
classes.description: Enum representing models that support cache control in content blocks, specifically 'claude' and 'gemini'.

classes.name: OpenrouterConfig
classes.description: Configuration class extending OpenAIGPTConfig, adding support for cache control, reasoning parameters, and cost extraction for OpenRouter models.

classes.name: OpenRouterChatCompletionStreamingHandler
classes.description: Handles streaming responses from OpenRouter, parsing chunks, handling errors, and extracting usage data.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns supported openai parameters, adding 'reasoning_effort' if reasoning is supported.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps parameters for OpenRouter, including transforms, models, and route, into the request body.

methods.name: _supports_cache_control_in_content
methods.description: Checks if a model supports cache control in content blocks based on its name.

methods.name: remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools
methods.description: Removes cache control flags from messages and tools if not supported by the model.

methods.name: _move_cache_control_to_content
methods.description: Moves cache control from message level to the last content block within messages for OpenRouter compatibility.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request payload, moving cache control if needed, and adds usage info.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Processes the API response, extracting cost info from headers and embedding it into the response object.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns an OpenRouterException for API errors.

methods.name: get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator handler for streaming responses.
